entitycount.config.master_toggle.tooltip: Enable or disable entity count display
entitycount.config.count_non_living.tool: Count lifeless critters (cannonballs, boats, an' such)
entitycount.config.filter_mode.tooltip: Blacklist: Hide blacklisted entities | Whitelist: Show only whitelisted entities
entitycount.config.text_color.tooltip: Set the text colour for entity count display
entitycount.config.background_color.tool: Set the background colour and transparency for entity count display
entitycount.config.type_limit.tooltip: Limit the maximum number of entity types displayed, -1 means unlimited
entitycount.config.threshold.tooltip: Only display entity types with count greater than or equal to this value, -1 means no limit
entitycount.config.count_range.tooltip:
Only count entities within this many chunks of the player (Chebyshev distance).
0 = current chunk only, 32 = count everything within render distance.
Note: cannot exceed the loaded chunks (render distance).
entitycount.config.whitelist_normal.tool: Only show entities in this list (when filter mode be whitelist)

entitycount.config.blacklist_normal.tool: Hide entities in this list (when filter mode be blacklist)
entitycount.config.blacklist_item.toolti: Hide loot in this list (when filter mode be blacklist)
entitycount.config.pinnedlist_normal.too: Entities in this list will always be shown at th' top
entitycount.config.pinnedlist_item.toolt: Item entities in this list will always be shown at th' top
entitycount.config.pinned_show_even_zero: Show pinned entities even when count is 0
